raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Summary

- clean up external attribution in NPU quantization comments and docstrings across the W8A8, W4A8, and W4A4 paths
- retain the implementation-specific layout, shape, version, and troubleshooting guidance
- keep runtime behavior, configuration, and public APIs unchanged

## Why

This documentation-only follow-up to #23650 makes the affected comments describe the SGLang implementation directly and keeps the terminology self-contained.

## Validation

- python -m py_compile on both modified files
- git diff --check
- no external project references remain in the two target files
- executable AST is unchanged after removing docstrings from the comparison

No NPU end-to-end test was run because this change only updates comments and docstrings.
